description: This file defines GraphQL schema extensions, including custom mutations and subscriptions, for a KeystoneJS project. It manages 'Post' and 'Author' lists, with hooks for publishing updates via pubSub.

methods.name: afterOperation
methods.description: Hook triggered after a post operation to publish 'POST_UPDATED' event via pubSub.

methods.name: publishPost
methods.description: Custom GraphQL mutation to publish a post, updating its status and publish date, then publishing 'POST_PUBLISHED' event.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscription resolvers for 'time', 'postPublished', and 'postUpdated' events using pubSub async iterators.
